title: Hallucination Is Linearly Decodable from Mid-Layer Hidden States in Quantized LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.02628v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate whether open-source LLMs encode a linearly separable truthfulness signal in their hidden states, and at which network depth this signal is strongest. Across three $7$B--$8$B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-7B) loaded in $4$-bit NF4 quantization, we extract per-layer hidden states on four hallucination benchmarks (TruthfulQA, HaluEval-QA, FEVER, and a controlled synthetic set) and compare four detection approaches: linear and MLP probes, INSIDE EigenScore, self-consistency, and attention entropy. A linear probe on a single mid-network layer achieves $0.904$--$1.000$ AUROC on held-out splits, while sampling-based detectors do not exceed $0.541$ AUROC under the same protocol. The truthfulness signal is approximately linear: MLP probes rarely surpass linear probes by more than $0.01$ AUROC. Peak probing layers fall in a consistent band across model families on natural-language benchmarks -- blocks

translated_title: 幻觉可从量化大语言模型的中间层隐藏状态中被线性解码
translated_abstract: 我们研究了开源大语言模型是否在其隐藏状态中编码了线性可分的真实性信号，以及该信号在网络哪个深度处最强。我们在三个经指令微调的7B–8B模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B）上以4-bit NF4量化加载，在四个幻觉基准（TruthfulQA、HaluEval-QA、FEVER以及一个受控合成数据集）上提取逐层隐藏状态，并比较了四种检测方法：线性探针与MLP探针、INSIDE EigenScore、自一致性以及注意力熵。在单个网络中间层上的线性探针在保留测试集上实现了0.904–1.000的AUROC，而基于采样的检测器在相同协议下AUROC不超过0.541。真实性信号近似线性：MLP探针很少能比线性探针高出0.01以上的AUROC。在自然语言基准上，各模型家族的峰值探测层落在一致的层区间内——块（注：摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 量化开源大语言模型的中间层隐藏状态中存在近似线性的真实性信号，仅用单个中间层的简单线性探针即可高效检测幻觉（AUROC达0.904–1.000），显著优于采样式检测方法。
en_tdlr: A simple linear probe on a single mid-layer of quantized 7B–8B LLMs detects hallucinations with 0.904–1.000 AUROC, revealing that truthfulness is encoded nearly linearly in mid-layer hidden states and far outperforming sampling-based detectors.
